from fractions import Fraction

# Atoms are tuples. Explicit negation is represented by a separate predicate.
facts = {
    ("age", "basenji", Fraction(3, 2)),
    ("name", "basenji", "Milo"),
    ("name", "seahorse", "Meadow"),
    ("money", "basenji", 90),
    ("money", "swan", 58),
    ("money", "german shepherd", 57),
    ("works_in_marketing", "fish"),
    ("brings_oil_tank", "mannikin", "duck"),
}
# Other narrative facts have predicates that occur in no rule antecedent.

names = {"basenji": "Milo", "seahorse": "Meadow"}
money = {"basenji": 90, "swan": 58, "german shepherd": 57}

if Fraction(3, 2) < 4:
    facts.add(("under_four", "basenji"))
if names["basenji"][0].casefold() == names["seahorse"][0].casefold():
    facts.add(("matching_initial", "basenji"))
if money["basenji"] > money["swan"] + money["german shepherd"]:
    facts.add(("more_than_combined_money", "basenji"))

animals = """
basenji bee songbird camel husky duck mannikin fish lizard ostrich owl
mouse reindeer pelikan seahorse shark swan cougar dachshund worm snake
badger seal bulldog zebra
""".split() + ["german shepherd"]

# Each rule is (identifier, required atoms, conclusion).
rules = [
    ("R1", {("leafy_green_vegetable", "fish")},
     ("not_take_over_emperor", "fish", "shark")),
    ("R2", {("under_four", "basenji")},
     ("company", "basenji", "badger")),
    ("R3", {("matching_initial", "basenji")},
     ("convinces", "basenji", "seal")),
    ("R4", {("more_than_combined_money", "basenji")},
     ("company", "basenji", "badger")),
    ("R6", {("brings_oil_tank", "mannikin", "duck")},
     ("not_unite", "duck", "zebra")),
    ("R8", {("works_in_marketing", "fish")},
     ("not_take_over_emperor", "fish", "shark")),
]
for animal in animals:
    rules.append((
        "R5",
        {("neglects", animal, "swan")},
        ("not_borrows", "basenji", "bulldog"),
    ))
    rules.append((
        "R7",
        {("convinces", animal, "seal"), ("company", animal, "badger")},
        ("borrows", animal, "bulldog"),
    ))

def closure(blocked):
    known = set(facts)
    while True:
        additions = {
            conclusion
            for label, body, conclusion in rules
            if (label, conclusion) not in blocked and body <= known
        }
        updated = known | additions
        if updated == known:
            return known
        known = updated

# First establish which antecedents are supported.
supported = closure(set())

# Rule 5 defeats the conflicting instance of Rule 7 only when Rule 5's
# existential antecedent is actually supported.
r5_applicable = any(
    label == "R5" and body <= supported
    for label, body, conclusion in rules
)
blocked = set()
if r5_applicable:
    blocked.add(("R7", ("borrows", "basenji", "bulldog")))

derived = closure(blocked)
positive = ("borrows", "basenji", "bulldog") in derived
negative = ("not_borrows", "basenji", "bulldog") in derived

if positive and not negative:
    expected = "PROVED"
elif negative and not positive:
    expected = "DISPROVED"
else:
    expected = "UNKNOWN"

print("Basenji age:", Fraction(3, 2), "< 4")
print("Name initials:", names["basenji"][0], names["seahorse"][0])
print("Money comparison:", 90, ">", 58 + 57, "is", 90 > 58 + 57)
print("Enjoys badger's company:",
      ("company", "basenji", "badger") in derived)
print("Convinces seal:", ("convinces", "basenji", "seal") in derived)
print("Rule 5 antecedent supported:", r5_applicable)
print("Borrows:", positive, "| Explicitly does not borrow:", negative)
print("Expected result:", expected)
print("CHECK PASS" if expected == "PROVED" else "CHECK FAIL")
